description: Continuous-LoRa example using formula (2.7) and experimental data from Dudarek and Martyniuk's pre-print on discrete-to-continuous LoRa parameter estimation.

hypotheses.name: class_sf
hypotheses.label: Nominal class SF (detected vs GT SF)

hypotheses.name: class_bw
hypotheses.label: Nominal class BW (detected vs GT BW)

hypotheses.name: measured_bw
hypotheses.label: Measured BW (box estimate vs GT BW)

hypotheses.name: class_bw < gt_bw (upscale)
hypotheses.label: Class BW upscaled to GT BW (beyond 10%)

hypotheses.name: class_bw > gt_bw (downscale)
hypotheses.label: Class BW downscaled to GT BW (beyond 10%)

hypotheses.name: class_bw within tol & sf wrong
hypotheses.label: Class BW within 10% of GT BW but class SF wrong
hypotheses.condition: abs(col('Class BW') - col('GT BW')) / col('GT BW') <= 0.10 and col('Class SF') != col('GT SF')

hypotheses.name: class_bw & sf ok, measured_bw off
hypotheses.label: Class BW and SF correct but measured BW off GT BW (beyond 10%)
hypotheses.condition: abs(col('Class BW') - col('GT BW')) / col('GT BW') <= 0.10 and col('Class SF') == col('GT SF') and abs(col('Measured BW') - col('GT BW')) / col('GT BW') > 0.10

hypotheses.name: class_bw & sf ok & measured ok (baseline)
hypotheses.label: All inputs correct: class BW, SF, and measured BW within tolerance (sanity check)
hypotheses.condition: abs(col('Class BW') - col('GT BW')) / col('GT BW') <= 0.10 and col('Class SF') == col('GT SF') and abs(col('Measured BW') - col('GT BW')) / col('GT BW') <= 0.10
